219	    @classmethod
220	    def from_call(cls, func, when, reraise=None):
221	        #: context of invocation: one of "setup", "call",
222	        #: "teardown", "memocollect"
223	        start = time()
224	        excinfo = None
225	        try:
226	            result = func()
227	        except:  # noqa
228	            excinfo = ExceptionInfo.from_current()
229	            if reraise is not None and excinfo.errisinstance(reraise):
230	                raise
231	            result = None
232	        stop = time()
233	        return cls(start=start, stop=stop, when=when, result=result, excinfo=excinfo)

236	        if self.excinfo is not None:
237	            status = "exception"

242	            status = "result"
243	        return "<CallInfo when={when!r} {status}: {value}>".format(
244	            when=self.when, value=value, status=status
